title: Interior and Undertow
author: Zephyrine Eastwick
blurb: Theo Galloway, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
